notes.title: Biped 2 release date!
notes.notes:
It's time for a big announcement, adventurers!

The release date is no longer a secret! Mark the day in your calendars, and get ready to embark on a brand new journey. 



Biped 2 launches November 5 on Steam with a cross-platform online COOP on GOG, the Epic Games Store, as well as on PlayStation 4 and 5, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and Series X|S. 



Please save the date and never miss it!

This is not the last surprise in our pipeline. Expect a totally unexpected one closer to the release. Add Biped 2 to your wishlist and you will be the first ones to know.

See you.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2560240/Biped_2/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Biped 2 Demo Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello, Bipeds!



We are extremely excited to present a new demo update! We’ve got lots of feedback and made awesome changes to make Biped 2 an even better game for everyone. 



So, what’s new? 

Peer-to-peer online connection — no more region selections or any other shenanigans. Now, coop mode works through the P2P connection system, which should drastically improve ping. connection quality and streamline the experience;

Easy and Hard mode selection — we’ve had lots of feedback about the puzzle difficulty and a need for a more relaxed experience, akin to the first game. We’ve added a new difficulty setting, so now you are in full control of your gameplay. Challenge lovers can tackle the hard mode, and if you are here just for the vibes with your friends, the easy mode is a perfect choice for you.

Brand new PVP mode — for the first time ever, Biped will have a 2 vs 2 PVP mode. Race your friends through the levels and see who is the fastest Biped! In the Demo, you can have a taste of one level in this new mode. 

Please share your feedback with us! It is a huge help for us, and we want to hear about your new experience with P2P connection, easy mode, and the PVP challenge. And don’t forget to wishlist and follow Biped 2 on Steam to be first to hear all the exciting news.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2560240/Biped_2/"][/dynamiclink]

Until next time, adventurers!

Some players have reported issues with the game's stability, and we have prepared a small patch that might fix these issues. notes.title: Update 2.0 has arrived
notes.notes:
Dear adventurers,

Hope you are feeling great.

We are here with great news. We have prepared a special update for you. The following parts were updated:

•	Increased network stability and moved to the updated SDK version of Photon.
•	Updated Unity engine that positively influenced the performance of the game.
•	Updated controller applet to ensure stability of the controller’s usage.

We have also updated Play Station and Xbox builds to assure you all get the updates. Nintendo version will get the Online COOP update later in October 2024 (passing the LotCheck). Moreover, we are working on PS5 version of the game so soon you will be able to get a free update for PS5!

Also, we will release a new Dev Diary for Biped 2 next week. We will show you several new mechanics and present the milestones delivery plan so that you were inform when you could first try the new game and the new mechanics.

Meanwhile, please, don’t forget to wishlist Biped 2 and follow the page on Steam to never miss the special information and the playtest announcement.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2560240/Biped_2/ 

Hope that you will have less issues with the game and will enjoy the gameplay.

See you in Biped!

notes.title: A new update for Biped Online COOP
notes.notes:
Dear Biped players,

We are happy to announce a new update for Biped Online COOP. You have asked us to add a possibility for players from different countries to play together and we have added it. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35776792/76fe51f6d0363c48feaa905cb70c73086a57aaf3.png

Now you could choose a region at the online COOP and play together at one region. Isn’t it fun?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35776792/3ee17df8d2bb2049bf32870e77d271185a206629.png

Unfortunately, such option is not available for China due to the Great Chinese Firewall. Fortunately, there are good news there as well: we have added Chinese – only server and now Chinese players won’t have any issues with Online COOP. We are sorry it took us so long to fix it but we made it at the end.

And last but not the least - a small reminder: Level Editor is available at the game and thanks to our awesome community there is a number of new levels there. Don’t hesitate to try it out now and vote there.

We hope that you will enjoy the update.

notes.title: Online matchmaking system update is live!
notes.notes:
Dear friends!

You were waiting patiently for another update that would fix the issues with the connection. And we made it! Now you will have a way better ping during online play and you will be able to play with your friends at your region via a matchmaking tool.

Achievements issues are fixed now and you will get it when you start playing the game. 

Please, note, that if you have played an old version of the game (before February 2022) then you need to copy-paste your old save files to the new folder:
1) Please, opened the folder: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/PostmetaGamesLimited/Biped
at your local PC.
2) Open the folder:
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/NExTStudios/Biped
Copy-paste all the files from the 2-nd folder to the first one and launch the game. It should solve your save files problem.

Also, we will leave the previous version (better ping) live if you want to keep playing it and do not need Level Editor or an online matchmaking tool. You could find the instructions on how to switch to the old version below:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1071870/view/3106925761785689322 

This version is needed if you are located in different regions!

Save files: we will keep the save files at the new place, i.e. here:
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/PostmetaGamesLimited/Biped
If you have just joined the game then nothing changes for you and you could keep on playing. If you have played the game before February 2022, please:

1) Please, opened the folder: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/PostmetaGamesLimited/Biped
at your local PC.
2) Open the folder:
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/NExTStudios/Biped
Copy-paste all the files from the 2-nd folder to the first one and launch the game.

We are working hard on further improvements and we will definitely let you know about the updates.

See you in Biped!

notes.title: An Update From Our Publisher!
notes.notes:
Hello, folks! How's it going? 

We have pleasant news from our publisher, META. Recently they've released Prologues for their upcoming games: Time Loader and HordeCore! We'd like to tell you a few words about them.

In Time Loader, you'll control a small robot and travel back to the 90s in an attempt to prevent a life-changing accident. If you like robots, branching story, and time travelling, spiced with all sorts of interesting puzzles, - it's a perfect game for you! Check it out here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35776792/393dd371514b232106a2b6a5d7aa1d8ac75aa009.jpg

HordeCore is a spicy one! Like our own Biped, the game is very co-op friendly and it's most fun with friends! It's a kick-ass action side-scroller set in a post-apocalyptic world, where you'll fight the Horde - a never-ending stream of [strike]zombies[/strike] undead. Gather your friends and join the fight!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35776792/525a1c96adad6209b3f4bfe89c125f567a95b9aa.png

As usual, stay tuned for our news! 
Have fun and be safe!

notes.title: April 17 v1.4 Patch Notes: Remote Play Together Supported Now
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Today, we are happy to announce that biped now supports Remote Play Together and mobile controls. The change means now you can share and play biped with a friend without needing them to be in the same room as you. And now you can play biped from your mobile phone through the app Steam Link, eliminating the need to worry about controllers any more. 

1. Now biped supports Remote Play Together:

Step 1: Launch biped
Step 2: Right-click on your friend on the list to send an invite 
Step 3: When an invite is accepted you can play the game without meeting up 

2. Now biped also supports mobile controls by Steam Link:

Step 1: Download and install the app Steam Link on your mobile phone
Step 2: Make sure your mobile phone and computer are on the same WiFi
Step 3: Launch the app and pair your mobile phone with your computer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35776792/6836d498ffb8e91eb2e9e6538403451d229141f1.png

Step 4: Launch the game from Steam and start playing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35776792/1e2c17f67ab91a597678ecd9c5c4c9e9658fbf36.png

Here is how the interface should look but you can remap it as you like
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35776792/c6c2148fa91d4ade33974f1498bee9ac6c087bf5.png

You can disable video and audio in Streaming Settings to reduce the lag
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35776792/b0da9068b18fef10e4dc65427f42d8cb36649294.png

Learn more about Remote Play Together from here: https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay
